jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

# Signature Maker React React component that lets users draw, type or upload their signature and returns it as a PNG. A thin wrapper around the [signature-maker-js](https://github.com/docusealco/signature-maker-js) web component. [Live demo](https://www.docuseal.com/online-signature) · [Documentation](https://www.docuseal.com/docs/embedded/signature#react) · [JS](https://github.com/docusealco/signature-maker-js) · [Vue](https://github.com/docusealco/signature-maker-vue) ## Installation ```bash npm install @docuseal/signature-maker-react # or yarn add @docuseal/signature-maker-react ``` Requires React 18 or 19. Works with server-side rendering. ## Usage No handlers needed: the Submit button downloads the signature as a PNG. ```jsx import { SignatureMaker } from '@docuseal/signature-maker-react' export function App() { return } ``` Handle the signature when the user clicks Submit: ```jsx import { SignatureMaker } from '@docuseal/signature-maker-react' export function App() { const handleSave = (detail) => { fetch('/save-signature', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ file: detail.base64 }), }) } return } ``` Embed in a form without the Submit button and track every change: ```jsx import { useState } from 'react' import { SignatureMaker } from '@docuseal/signature-maker-react' export function App() { const [signatureBase64, setSignatureBase64] = useState(null) const handleSubmit = (event) => { event.preventDefault() fetch('/submit-form', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ name: event.target.name.value, signature: signatureBase64 }), }) } return (
setSignatureBase64(detail.base64)} /> ) } ``` Restyle with CSS classes and translate the labels. A full DaisyUI example: ```jsx import React from 'react' import { SignatureMaker } from '@docuseal/signature-maker-react' export function App() { return (
); } ``` ## Events | Prop | When | Argument | |---|---|---| | `onSave` | Submit button clicked | `{ base64, blob }` | | `onChange` | Signature drawn, typed, uploaded or cleared | `{ base64, blob }`, both `null` when empty | `ref` gives access to the underlying element with `enableDrawPanel()`, `enableTextPanel()`, `enableUploadPanel()` and the [signature_pad](https://github.com/szimek/signature_pad) instance as `pad`. TypeScript declarations are included: ```tsx import { useRef } from 'react' import { SignatureMaker, type SignatureDetail, type SignatureMakerElement } from '@docuseal/signature-maker-react' const ref = useRef(null) const handleSave = (detail: SignatureDetail) => console.log(detail.base64) ``` ## Props Behavior: | Prop | Default | Description | |---|---|---| | `withDrawn` | `true` | Show the Draw tab | | `withTyped` | `true` | Show the Type tab | | `withUpload` | `true` | Show the Upload tab | | `withColorSelect` | `true` | Show the pen color picker | | `withSubmit` | `true` | Show the Submit button | | `downloadOnSave` | `false` | Download the PNG on Submit | | `fontUrl` | Dancing Script | WOFF font used for typed signatures | | `className`, `style` | | Applied to the `` element itself | Labels: `saveButtonText`, `undoButtonText`, `clearButtonText`, `drawTypeButtonText`, `textTypeButtonText`, `uploadTypeButtonText`, `textInputPlaceholder`. Styles: every element below accepts `Class` and `Style` (a CSS string). A class replaces the default inline styles, a style overrides them. State variants are appended to the base class or style. | Element | State variants | |---|---| | `saveButton` | `saveButtonDisabledClass`, `saveButtonsDisabledStyle` | | `drawTypeButton`, `textTypeButton`, `uploadTypeButton` | `ActiveClass`, `ActiveStyle` | | `undoButton`, `clearButton`, `textInput`, `canvas`, `typeButtonsContainer`, `controlButtonsContainer` | | Example: `drawTypeButtonClass="tab"` plus `drawTypeButtonActiveClass="tab-active"` renders `class="tab tab-active"` while Draw is selected. ## License MIT

import path from 'node:path' import { build } from 'esbuild' import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test' const BUNDLE = path.join(__dirname, '../test-results/props-app.js') const BOOLEAN_PROPS = ['downloadOnSave', 'withTyped', 'withDrawn', 'withUpload', 'withColorSelect', 'withSubmit'] const STRING_PROPS = [ 'fontUrl', 'controlButtonsContainerClass', 'controlButtonsContainerStyle', 'saveButtonText', 'saveButtonClass', 'saveButtonStyle', 'saveButtonDisabledClass', 'saveButtonsDisabledStyle', 'undoButtonText', 'undoButtonClass', 'undoButtonStyle', 'clearButtonText', 'clearButtonClass', 'clearButtonStyle', 'textInputPlaceholder', 'textInputClass', 'textInputStyle', 'canvasClass', 'canvasStyle', 'typeButtonsContainerClass', 'typeButtonsContainerStyle', 'drawTypeButtonText', 'drawTypeButtonClass', 'drawTypeButtonStyle', 'drawTypeButtonActiveClass', 'drawTypeButtonActiveStyle', 'textTypeButtonText', 'textTypeButtonClass', 'textTypeButtonStyle', 'textTypeButtonActiveClass', 'textTypeButtonActiveStyle', 'uploadTypeButtonText', 'uploadTypeButtonClass', 'uploadTypeButtonStyle', 'uploadTypeButtonActiveClass', 'uploadTypeButtonActiveStyle', ] const ATTRIBUTE_OVERRIDES: Record = { saveButtonsDisabledStyle: 'data-save-button-disabled-style' } const attributeName = (prop: string) => ATTRIBUTE_OVERRIDES[prop] || `data-${prop.replace(/[A-Z]/g, (char) => `-${char.toLowerCase()}`)}` test.beforeAll(async () => { await build({ entryPoints: [path.join(__dirname, 'app.tsx')], bundle: true, outfile: BUNDLE, jsx: 'automatic', define: { 'process.env.NODE_ENV': '"development"' }, logLevel: 'silent', }) }) test('every prop is rendered as its data attribute', async ({ page }) => { const props: Record = {} for (const prop of BOOLEAN_PROPS) props[prop] = prop === 'downloadOnSave' for (const prop of STRING_PROPS) props[prop] = `${prop}-value` await page.setContent('
') await page.evaluate((props) => ((window as any).props = props), props) await page.addScriptTag({ path: BUNDLE }) const el = page.locator('signature-maker') await expect(el).toHaveCount(1) for (const prop of BOOLEAN_PROPS) { await expect(el).toHaveAttribute(attributeName(prop), String(prop === 'downloadOnSave')) } for (const prop of STRING_PROPS) { await expect(el).toHaveAttribute(attributeName(prop), `${prop}-value`) } const names = await el.evaluate((node) => node.getAttributeNames().filter((name) => name.startsWith('data-'))) expect(names.sort()).toEqual([...BOOLEAN_PROPS, ...STRING_PROPS].map(attributeName).sort()) }) test('props that are undefined or empty are not rendered', async ({ page }) => { await page.setContent('
') await page.evaluate(() => ((window as any).props = { withUpload: undefined, saveButtonText: '', fontUrl: undefined })) await page.addScriptTag({ path: BUNDLE }) const el = page.locator('signature-maker') await expect(el).toHaveCount(1) await expect(el).not.toHaveAttribute('data-font-url') await expect(el).not.toHaveAttribute('data-with-upload') await expect(el).not.toHaveAttribute('data-save-button-text') await expect(page.locator('[data-target="saveButton"]')).toHaveText('Submit') await expect(page.locator('[data-target="uploadTypeButton"]')).toBeVisible() })

import { defineConfig, devices } from '@playwright/test'

export default defineConfig({
	testDir: 'tests',
	forbidOnly: !!process.env.CI,
	retries: process.env.CI ? 1 : 0,
	reporter: 'list',
	projects: [{ name: 'chrome', use: { ...devices['Desktop Chrome'], channel: 'chrome' } }],
})

export { SignatureMaker, type SignatureMakerProps, type SignatureDetail, type SignatureMakerElement } from './SignatureMaker'
export { SignatureMaker as default } from './SignatureMaker'

import { createElement, forwardRef, useEffect, useImperativeHandle, useRef, type CSSProperties } from 'react'
import '@docuseal/signature-maker-js'
import type { SignatureDetail, SignatureMakerElement } from '@docuseal/signature-maker-js'

export type { SignatureDetail, SignatureMakerElement }

export interface SignatureMakerProps {
	downloadOnSave?: boolean
	withTyped?: boolean
	withDrawn?: boolean
	withUpload?: boolean
	withColorSelect?: boolean
	withSubmit?: boolean
	fontUrl?: string
	controlButtonsContainerClass?: string
	controlButtonsContainerStyle?: string
	saveButtonText?: string
	saveButtonClass?: string
	saveButtonStyle?: string
	saveButtonDisabledClass?: string
	saveButtonsDisabledStyle?: string
	undoButtonText?: string
	undoButtonClass?: string
	undoButtonStyle?: string
	clearButtonText?: string
	clearButtonClass?: string
	clearButtonStyle?: string
	textInputPlaceholder?: string
	textInputClass?: string
	textInputStyle?: string
	canvasClass?: string
	canvasStyle?: string
	typeButtonsContainerClass?: string
	typeButtonsContainerStyle?: string
	drawTypeButtonText?: string
	drawTypeButtonClass?: string
	drawTypeButtonStyle?: string
	drawTypeButtonActiveClass?: string
	drawTypeButtonActiveStyle?: string
	textTypeButtonText?: string
	textTypeButtonClass?: string
	textTypeButtonStyle?: string
	textTypeButtonActiveClass?: string
	textTypeButtonActiveStyle?: string
	uploadTypeButtonText?: string
	uploadTypeButtonClass?: string
	uploadTypeButtonStyle?: string
	uploadTypeButtonActiveClass?: string
	uploadTypeButtonActiveStyle?: string
	className?: string
	style?: CSSProperties
	onSave?: (detail: SignatureDetail) => void
	onChange?: (detail: SignatureDetail) => void
}

const ATTRIBUTE_OVERRIDES: Record<string, string> = { saveButtonsDisabledStyle: 'data-save-button-disabled-style' }

const toAttributeName = (prop: string) => ATTRIBUTE_OVERRIDES[prop] || `data-${prop.replace(/[A-Z]/g, (char) => `-${char.toLowerCase()}`)}`

export const SignatureMaker = forwardRef<SignatureMakerElement, SignatureMakerProps>(function SignatureMaker(
	{ className, style, onSave, onChange, ...options },
	ref,
) {
	const elementRef = useRef<SignatureMakerElement>(null)

	useImperativeHandle(ref, () => elementRef.current!, [])

	useEffect(() => {
		const el = elementRef.current

		if (!el || !onSave) return

		const handler = (e: CustomEvent<SignatureDetail>) => onSave(e.detail)

		el.addEventListener('save', handler)

		return () => el.removeEventListener('save', handler)
	}, [onSave])

	useEffect(() => {
		const el = elementRef.current

		if (!el || !onChange) return

		const handler = (e: CustomEvent<SignatureDetail>) => onChange(e.detail)

		el.addEventListener('change', handler)

		return () => el.removeEventListener('change', handler)
	}, [onChange])

	const attributes: Record<string, unknown> = { ref: elementRef, className, style }

	for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(options)) {
		if (value !== undefined && value !== '') attributes[toAttributeName(key)] = String(value)
	}

	return createElement('signature-maker', attributes)
})

export default SignatureMaker
